공식 웹페이지 - 한국 공식 X - 영문 공식 X

## Flare

Flare는 그동안 활용되지 못했던 디지털 자산을 실질적으로 운용 가능한 자본으로 전환하는 데이터 및 컴퓨팅 레이어입니다. XRPFi는 이를 보여주는 첫 번째이자 가장 대표적인 사례입니다. FXRP를 통해 XRP 홀더들은 그동안 스마트 컨트랙트 생태계 밖에 머물러 있던 XRP를 대출과 볼트(Vault)를 비롯한 온체인 금융에 활용할 수 있습니다. 현재까지 1억 5천만 XRP 이상이 Flare로 이동했습니다.

공식 웹페이지 (https://xrpfi.flare.network/)- 한국 공식 [X](https://x.com/FlareNetworksKR)- 영문 공식 [X](https://x.com/FlareNetworks)

## SOIL

SOIL은 XRP Ledger 위에 네이티브로 구축된 기관급 수익 프로토콜입니다. 래핑도 브리징도 없이 XRP와 RLUSD를 온체인 볼트에서 운용합니다. 수익은 토큰 인센티브가 아니라 실제 기관 전략 - 프라임 브로커-헤지펀드 대상 담보 대출, 프라이빗 크레딧, 마켓 뉴트럴 디지털 자산 헤지펀드 배분 - 에서 나오며, 규제 자산운용 분야에서 다년간의 트랙 레코드를 쌓아온 팀이 직접 운용합니다. SOIL은 폴란드와 몰타의 라이선스 자산운용사 및 펀드를 통해 3억 1천만 달러 이상을 운용하는 ORQO Digital의 일원입니다.

공식 웹페이지 (https://soil.co) - 공식 [X](https://x.com/FlareNetworks)- 링크드인 (https://linkedin.com/company/soilfarm)

## t54

t54 Labs는 에이전틱 이코노미(agentic economy)를 위한 신뢰 레이어를 만듭니다. 기관과 애플리케이션이 에이전트의 신원과 의도를 검증하고, 자금이 움직이기 전에 거래-상대방 리스크를 평가하며, 컴플라이언스와 책임 추적을 위한 증적을 남길 수 있도록 리스크-언더라이팅 인프라를 제공합니다. 또한 이러한 통제 장치를 에이전트가 실제로 거래하는 프로토콜과 금융 레일 위에 구현하는 에이전틱 금융 인프라를 개발하고 있습니다.

공식 웹페이지 (https://t54.ai) - 공식 [X](https://x.com/t54ai)- 한국 텔레그램 채널 (https://t.me/t54ai_Korea)

## Santiment

가격은 무슨 일이 일어났는지 알려주지만, Santiment는 그 주변에서 사람들이 무엇을 했는지 보여줍니다 - 거래소에서 빠져나가는 코인, 조용해진 고래, 돌아서는 심리. 2016년부터 비트코인, 이더리움을 비롯한 2,800개 이상 자산의 온체인-소셜-금융 데이터를 펀드, 트레이더, 애널리스트에게 제공해 왔습니다.

공식 웹페이지 (https://santiment.net/) - 텔레그램 채널 (https://t.me/santiment_network) - 디스코드 커뮤니티 (https://discord.com/invite/MRya3zxh5u)

## SIVAX

SIVAX는 XRP Ledger 기반의 구조화 수익 플랫폼입니다. 전통 금융에서 검증된 구조화 전략(ex. FCN, ELS, 커버드콜 등)을 상시 운용 펀드 하나에 담아 온체인으로 옮겼고, 진입 후 배분-헤징-리스크 관리는 전략 엔진이 처리합니다. 수익의 원천이 토큰 인센티브나 레버리지 수요가 아닌 변동성이라 기존 web3 수익과 상관관계가 낮고, 이미 운용 중인 전략 위에 더할 수 있는 별도의 수익 레이어가 됩니다. 자산은 온체인 볼트에서 누구나 확인할 수 있으며 수익은 매일 지급됩니다.

공식 웹페이지 (https://sivax.io) - 공식 [X](https://x.com/sivax_official)

## XRPfi Night Seoul

Official side event of XRP Seoul 2026 - Korea Blockchain Week 2026

 Please note: This event is an educational-focused session on XRPfi, rather than a casual networking gathering. Attendance is strictly reserved for actual XRP holders who are genuinely eager to learn and explore on-chain XRPfi opportunities. We kindly ask that only those dedicated to gaining practical insights and learning from the teams register for this event.

Meet the XRP Community and XRPfi Projects in Seoul

Join XRPfi Night Seoul, hosted by DCENT as an official side event of XRP Seoul 2026. The event takes place during Korea Blockchain Week 2026, on the evening before the main XRP Seoul conference.

Global XRPL communities visiting Seoul for XRP Seoul week - including XRPL EU and XRPL Japan - will gather together with Korea's XRP holders for one evening. Hear sessions from the teams building real services on XRPL, experience XRPfi hands-on at the partner booths, and connect with people who hold the same asset you do.

If you hold XRP but haven't yet explored what you can do with it on-chain, this is the night to find out.

## Event Information

- Date: Friday, October 2, 2026 - 5:00 PM - 9:00 PM
- Venue: Shared after registration
- Host: DCENT
- Sponsors: Flare - SOIL - t54 - Santiment - SIVAX
- Language: Primarily Korean, with separate sessions in English

 This is an approval-only event. Confirmation will be shared separately, and entry is limited to approved guests.

## What You'll Discover

Where XRPfi goes next

Payments, tokenized assets and on-chain finance are converging on XRP. The teams building it will walk through where the XRPfi ecosystem is heading, from vaults and swaps to AI-powered tools.

What you can use today

How to put the XRP you hold to work on-chain, how to send and trade assets natively on XRP, and how next-generation tools from automation to AI are being used in practice.

Hands-on at the booths

At the partner booths, open throughout the evening, you can walk through your first deposit from start to finish and try the products at the demo kiosks. Ask each project team your questions directly, and join the giveaways on site.

## Event Program

- 17:00 Registration & welcome - booths open, finger food & drinks
- 17:20 Opening
- Full program to be announced
- 19:35 Networking & booth experience
- 21:00 Close

※ The detailed program and speaker lineup will be updated.

## Lucky Draw

Two lucky draws will be held for guests during the event. Prizes and how to enter will be announced.

## Who Should Attend?

- XRP holders who want to know how to use their assets on-chain
- Anyone who has heard of XRPfi and is looking for a place to start
- Anyone who wants to connect with the XRPL community, in Korea and abroad
- Builders and project teams looking for opportunities in the XRP ecosystem
- Anyone who wants to meet KOLs and creators in person

## ABOUT DCENT

DCENT is a self-custody wallet built to make owning and using cryptocurrencies secure and simple. Supporting 100+ blockchain networks and 10,000+ digital assets, DCENT serves 1M+ app users worldwide. Beyond secure storage, DCENT connects users to XRPFi, swaps, DeFi, dApps, and more, making it easier to explore and use the growing on-chain ecosystem while staying in control of their assets.

Beyond Storage. Own Your Future, At Ease.

[Official Website](https://www.dcentwallet.com) - X (Korea) (https://x.com/DCENTWALLETS_KR) - X (Global) (https://x.com/DCENTWALLETS)

## Flare

Flare is the data and compute layer that turns dormant digital assets into working capital. XRPFi is the first and largest example. Through FXRP, XRP holders can take an asset that has largely lived outside smart contract ecosystems and put it to work in onchain finance, such as lending and vaults. More than 150 million XRP has already moved onto Flare.

[Official Website](https://xrpfi.flare.network) - X (Korea) (https://x.com/FlareNetworksKR) - X (Global) (https://x.com/FlareNetworks)

## SOIL

SOIL is an institutional-grade yield protocol built natively on the XRP Ledger. It puts XRP and RLUSD to work in on-chain vaults - no wrapping, no bridging. Yield is generated from real institutional strategies, not token emissions: secured lending to prime brokers and hedge funds, private credit, and allocations to market-neutral digital asset hedge funds - all run by a team with a multi-year track record in regulated asset management. SOIL is part of ORQO Digital, a group with $310M+ under management across licensed asset managers and funds in Poland and Malta.

[Official Website](https://soil.co) - [X](https://x.com/soil_farm) - [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/company/soilfarm)

## t54

t54 Labs is building the trust layer for the agentic economy. It provides risk and underwriting infrastructure that helps institutions and applications verify agent identity and intent, assess transaction and counterparty risk before money moves, and preserve evidence for compliance and accountability. t54 also develops agentic financial infrastructure that brings these controls to the protocols and financial rails where agents transact.

[Official Website](https://t54.ai) - [X](https://x.com/t54ai) - Telegram (Korea) (https://t.me/t54ai_Korea)

## Santiment

Price tells you what happened. Santiment shows what people did around it - coins moving off exchanges, whales going quiet, sentiment turning. Since 2016, Santiment has supplied funds, traders, and analysts with on-chain, social, and financial data on Bitcoin, Ethereum, and 2,800+ other assets.

[Official Website](https://santiment.net) - [Telegram](https://t.me/santiment_network) - [Discord](https://discord.gg/MRya3zxh5u)

## SIVAX

SIVAX is a structured income platform on the XRP Ledger. It takes strategies that have been running in traditional finance for decades (e.g. FCNs, ELS, covered calls) and puts them in a single always-on fund. You enter once, and the engine handles allocation, hedging and risk from there. Returns come from volatility rather than token emissions or leverage demand, so they have little correlation with staking, LP or lending yields. SIVAX is a layer you add to a web3 portfolio, not one you swap in. Assets sit in an on-chain vault anyone can verify, and payouts go out daily.

[Official Website](https://sivax.io) - [X](https://x.com/sivax_official)

name: Payment 3.0：ステーブルコインは、本当に街で使えるのか。
description:
「発行」から「使う」へ。

ステーブルコインを、日常の決済に。JPYC・Sui / Mysten Labs・HashPort・INSPAYの実践者とともに、普及への課題を語り、会場で実際の支払いを体験する一夜です。

2026.10.02（金）｜18:00-20:30｜FINOLAB講演・パネルディスカッション・決済体験・ネットワーキング日本語中心／Bauer Wannの講演は英語・日本語通訳付き（予定）

Payment 3.0とは

本イベントでは、ステーブルコインなどのプログラマブルなデジタルマネーが、既存の金融・決済インフラとつながり、新たな決済体験やサービスを生み出していく次のフェーズを「Payment 3.0」と捉えます。

「発行・保有・送金」の先にある、日常で「使う」体験へ。INSPAYが京都やWebX 2026で取り組んできた実証をもとに、発行・ウォレット・加盟店導入の各視点から、その実現に必要な一歩を探ります。

登壇者｜Speakers

1．Bauer Wann

Mysten Labs｜Chief of Staff（参謀長）

Mysten LabsのCPO Adeniyi AbiodunのChief of Staff。消費者向けテクノロジーとブロックチェーン分野で13年以上のプロダクト戦略経験を持つ。Suiの消費者向け製品とSlushの成長を率い、以前はThunderCoreのアジア地域責任者を務めた。今回はSui・Slushと日常決済の接点を紹介する。

2．岡部典孝

JPYC株式会社｜代表取締役

日本円ステーブルコインを手がけるJPYC株式会社の代表取締役。2001年、一橋大学在学中に起業。2017年にリアルワールドゲームスを共同創業し、2019年に現在のJPYC株式会社を設立。経営と技術の両面で事業をつくってきた経験から、日本の市場と日常決済への普及を語る。

3．中山貴人

株式会社HashPort｜ビジネス開発部長 兼 大阪支社長

リクルート、C Channelを経て、コインチェック／マネックスグループでNFT・メタバース事業に従事。2024年にHashPortへ入社し、「EXPO2025デジタルウォレット」の企業連携を推進。今回はウォレットから加盟店・自動販売機への導入まで、普及に向けた実践を語る。

4．田中夏子

INSPAY｜事業開発責任者

INSPAYの事業開発責任者として、ステーブルコインと実店舗の決済をつなぐ取り組みに携わる。Sui Japanの公開対談では、Mysten Labsとともに決済速度や使いやすさ、既存端末を活用した導入の可能性を紹介。今回は自動販売機・展示会での実践と、日本から海外への展開を語る。

古田鴻之介

CoinPost｜事業開発部長（モデレーター）

CoinPostの事業開発部門を統括。WebX 2026では、コインチェック、ソニーグループ、au Coincheck Digital Assetsが登壇するセッションのモデレーターを担当。ポイントやエンターテインメント、既存ビジネスとの接点を通じて、暗号資産・ブロックチェーンが日常生活へ広がる可能性を議論した。

プログラム（予定）｜Program

1．オープニング田中夏子（INSPAY）／日本語自動販売機・展示会での実証を振り返り、本日の論点を共有します。

2．単独講演｜Special TalkBauer Wann（Mysten Labs）／英語・日本語通訳付き（予定）Sui・Slushと日常決済の接点を紹介します。

3．パネルディスカッション岡部典孝 × 中山貴人 × 田中夏子／日本語日本の市場、加盟店・自動販売機への導入、日本から海外への展開を議論します。モデレーター：古田鴻之介（CoinPost｜事業開発部長）。参加者からのQ&Aも予定しています。

4．ステーブルコイン決済体験JPYC・USDC on Suiによる支払いを会場で体験。

5．ネットワーキング軽食・ドリンクとともに、登壇者や参加者同士で交流いただけます。

※詳細なタイムテーブルは後日公開します。プログラムは変更となる場合があります。

話す、その先の体験へ。

ウォレットで支払い、商品を受け取る。INSPAYの決済端末や自動販売機を通じて、JPYCとUSDC on Suiが実際の買い物につながる瞬間をお試しください。

自動販売機での決済体験｜WebX 2026

クレーンゲームでの決済体験｜WebX 2026※写真は過去の展示・体験の様子です。

こんな方におすすめ

金融・決済・ブロックチェーン関連事業者、小売・流通、事業会社、VC / CVC、メディアの方。Web3業界に限らず、ステーブルコインの実用化や、これからの決済に関心のある方を歓迎します。

English at a glance

Join JPYC, Sui / Mysten Labs, HashPort and INSPAY to explore stablecoins in everyday payments, followed by hands-on JPYC and USDC payments on Sui and networking.

October 2, 2026 - 18:00-20:30 JST - FINOLAB, TokyoThe opening and panel are in Japanese. Bauer Wann's talk is in English with Japanese interpretation planned. Panel moderator: Konosuke Furuta, Head of Business Development at CoinPost. A detailed timetable will be announced later. Programme subject to change.

主催・パートナー

INSPAY 公式サイト　／　X @INSPAY_ioINSPAY プライバシーポリシー

name: OnlyBulls x Ault Markets in Seoul
description:
OnlyBulls x Ault Markets in Seoul

OnlyBulls와 Ault Markets가 함께하는 특별한 오프라인 네트워킹 이벤트에 여러분을 초대합니다.

크립토 투자자, 트레이더, Web3 관계자, 크리에이터는 물론 Ault Markets와 OnlyBulls에 관심 있는 분이라면 누구나 신청하실 수 있습니다.

이번 행사는 단순한 프로젝트 소개를 넘어, 트레이딩과 디지털 자산, Web3를 중심으로 국내외 업계 관계자와 투자자들이 자연스럽게 교류할 수 있는 네트워킹 자리로 준비하고 있습니다.

특히 KBW 기간에 맞춰 진행되는 만큼 다양한 크립토 인플루언서와 업계 관계자들이 함께할 예정입니다.

국내 구독자 10만~20만 명 이상 규모의 주요 크립토 유튜버들도 다수 참석 예정이며, 프로젝트뿐만 아니라 새로운 사람과 네트워크를 만나고 싶은 분들에게도 특별한 자리가 될 수 있도록 준비하고 있습니다.

또한 편안하게 네트워킹을 즐기실 수 있도록 스파클링 와인 100병과 레드와인 50병을 비롯한 다양한 주류와 케이터링, 먹거리도 함께 준비될 예정입니다.

프로젝트와 시장에 대한 이야기부터 새로운 비즈니스와 네트워크까지, 음악과 함께 자유롭게 대화를 나누며 새로운 연결을 만들어갈 수 있는 밤을 준비하고 있습니다.

 About Ault Markets

Ault Markets는 Ault Blockchain을 기반으로 구축된 금융 플랫폼입니다.

트레이딩, 포트폴리오 관리, 시장 데이터, 리서치 기능을 하나의 통합된 플랫폼에서 제공하는 것을 목표로 하고 있습니다.

첫 번째 제품은 자체 Spot 오더북 거래소이며, 향후 플랫폼 확장에 따라 무기한 선물(Perpetuals), 대출(Lending), 마진 거래, Vaults, 토큰화 자산 등의 기능도 추가될 예정입니다.

 About OnlyBulls

OnlyBulls is a self-custody wallet built for people who want more from their crypto.

Sign up with an email or social login and your wallet is ready in seconds. No seed phrase setup, no browser extension, no second app. Your keys, your assets, always.

Most wallets stop at storing and swapping. OnlyBulls is where you actually put your money to work:

name: Metropolis Hackathon Builder Day: London | $250,000 in prizes
description:
Monad Metropolis is Monad's flagship global hackathon - six weeks, online-first, $250,000 in prizes. This is the London hacker house: one day at Encode Hub to meet other builders working on Metropolis, get your questions answered, and put real hours into your submission.

Metropolis runs 1 September to 13 October. Wherever you are in that window - still shaping an idea, looking for teammates, or deep in the build - this day is for you.

## What to expect

Morning: around two hours of talks and workshops. A technical session run by Monad's engineering team, plus speakers on the things that decide whether a hackathon project becomes a company - go-to-market, fundraising, business model, community and hiring.

Rest of the day: coworking. Desks, fast wifi, coffee, and mentors on the floor.
Come with a team or find one here.

## The Tracks

Onchain Finance & Trading - asset primitives and market infrastructure that only work with fast settlement.

Consumer Products & Payments - crypto that doesn't feel like crypto. Social payments, salary streaming, programmable gifts.

Social, Attention & Culture - open social graphs, attention markets, generative art, competitive feeds.

Trust, Identity & AI Infrastructure - primitives for an AI-native internet. Proof of personhood, content passports, data lockers.

## Prizes

$250,000 total. $30,000 overall winner, $30,000 per track, plus 20+ sponsor bounties from Dynamic, Privy, Perpl, Nansen, Chainlink, Agora, Kuru, MetaMask and others.

## Who should come

Developers, designers and founders building on Monad - or curious about it. Solo builders welcome; teams form on the day. You don't need prior Monad experience, but bring a laptop.

Registration is free and capacity is limited.

Register for Metropolis itself at hackathon.monad.xyz - this event is a London meetup during the build window, not a substitute for entering.
location: Encode Hub, 41 Pitfield St, London N1 6DA, UK

description:

ビットコインをきっかけに集まる、持ち込みスタイルのカジュアルな交流会

トーク内容は自由！

難しい講義やステージでの発表は一切ありません。初心者の方も、ベテランの方も、輪になって会話を楽しむだけ。ビットコインの最新ニュースから、そもそもビットコインって何？という素朴な疑問まで、どんな話題も大歓迎です。

A casual, BYOB meetup where people come together over Bitcoin

Win: Claim your share of the prize.

name: [Lambda256] Join the Blockchain Node Crew ! - 신입 크루 집중 모집
description:
## 이벤트 소개

본격적으로 금융과 맞물리기 시작한 블록체인. 결제, 자산 토큰화(RWA), 거래소 인프라까지 현재 일어나는 모든 블록체인X금융 사업의 선두에 람다256이 있습니다. 어디에서도 들을 수 없는, 저희가 직접 보고 겪은 금융 시장 최전선의 이야기를 나누고자 합니다.

이번에 람다256에서 소개할 노드 운영 직군은 블록체인 네트워크에 직접 연결되는 서버를 구축하고 운영하며, 블록체인 인프라의 안정적인 운영을 책임지는 핵심 역할입니다. 그동안은 소수의 인프라 조직이 담당해왔지만, 국내 금융업계에서 디지털 자산 기술 검증(PoC)이 본격화되면서, 이제는 금융권 수준의 안정성과 데이터 정합성까지 요구되고 있습니다. 블록체인과 금융의 접점이 넓어질수록, 안정적인 네트워크 운영을 책임지는 노드 운영의 중요성도 더욱 커지고 있습니다.

 신입 크루를 모시기에 앞서, 이러한 변화 속에서 노드 운영이 실제로 어떤 일을 하는지, 그리고 그 역할이 왜 중요한지 소개하는 자리를 마련했습니다. 현직자의 이야기와 라이브 데모를 통해 실제 업무와 현장을 가까이에서 경험하실 수 있습니다.

## 이런 분께 권해드립니다

- 블록체인 인프라가 실제로 어떻게 운영되는지, 그 구조와 원리를 이해하고 싶은 분
- 애플리케이션 개발을 넘어, 시스템을 안정적으로 운영하는 영역에 관심 있는 분

- 노드 운영 직무로 첫 커리어를 시작하고자 하는 대학생-졸업예정자-주니어 개발자

16:30 - 16:40 ㅣ Welcome Speech

- 노드 운영이 하는 일 - 팀 소개 & 라이브 데모 - 정준호, 람다256 노드운영팀

세션별 시간은 현장 상황에 따라 일부 조정될 수 있습니다.

## 이벤트 장소

- 업비트 라운지(Upbit Lounge) - 서울 강남역 인근 소재

## 접수 안내

장소 여건상 더 많은 분을 모시지 못하는 점 양해 부탁드립니다. 신청서를 작성해주신 분을 대상으로 접수 순서에 따라 참가 신청을 검토하며, 선착순 70분께 최종 참석 여부를 개별 안내드립니다.

원활한 행사 운영을 위해 신청서의 필수 항목을 모두 작성해주시길 부탁드리며, 작성해주신 내용을 바탕으로 참가 대상 여부를 확인하고 있습니다. 많은 분들의 관심과 참여 부탁드립니다.

*유의사항: 이번 행사는 승인제로 운영됩니다. 신청 순서대로 검토해 행사 등록이 승인되며, 참석 확정 메일을 받으실 수 있습니다. 신청서 필수 항목이 누락되었거나 작성 내용으로 참가 대상 여부를 확인하기 어려운 경우 승인이 어려울 수 있습니다.

## 노드 크루로 합류하기 (채용 안내)

노드 운영 신입 채용 지원 방법은 행사 현장에서 안내드립니다. 참석 후 지원하시면 전형에서 우대를 받으실 수 있습니다.

람다256에서 채용 중인 경력 및 다른 분야의 포지션은 아래 페이지에서 확인하실 수 있으니 지원 공고 및 자격을 확인해보세요.

채용 페이지(바로가기) (https://lambda256.career.greetinghr.com/ko/intro)

## About Nodit

노딧(Nodit)은 람다256이 운영하는 엔터프라이즈 온체인 인프라 플랫폼입니다. 50개 이상의 블록체인 네트워크에서 노드를 운영하며 일 평균 4억 건 이상의 트랜잭션을 처리하고, 업비트, 코인원, 디지털X 등 국내 주요 거래소와 금융기관이 도입했습니다. 국내 블록체인 기술기업 최초로 SOC 2 Type I-II 인증을 획득한 운영 체계를 기반으로, 업비트를 비롯한 대규모 디지털 자산 서비스 운영 경험을 살려 디지털 자산 생태계를 지탱하는 핵심 인프라를 만들어가고 있습니다.

[Website](https://www.nodit.io/) l X(Twitter) (https://x.com/NoditPlatform) [l Linkedin](https://www.linkedin.com/company/lambda256/)

## About Lambda256

람다256은 금융기관이 디지털 자산 비즈니스를 안전하게 도입하고 운영할 수 있게 하는 온체인 금융 플랫폼을 제공하는 블록체인 전문 기술기업입니다. 두나무의 블록체인 연구소에서 출발해 2019년 설립된 이후, 엔터프라이즈급 블록체인 노드-데이터 풀스택 인프라 플랫폼 노딧(Nodit), 온체인 AML/FDS 컴플라이언스 플랫폼 클레어(CLAIR), 그리고 온체인 금융 오케스트레이션 플랫폼 스코프(SCOPE)를 중심으로 블록체인 기술의 상용화와 금융 데이터 생태계 조성을 선도하고 있습니다.

## What does the next generation of AI-powered commerce look like?

ZooWork and AI Valley are bringing together builders, founders, engineers, designers, and commerce leaders for AI Commerce Gallery - a curated one-day hackathon and interactive showcase for products pushing commerce forward.

On October 3rd, AI Commerce Gallery takes over The Walt Disney Family Museum in San Francisco for a full day of building, demos, and exploration.

Teams will build throughout the day in the Diane Disney Miller Exhibition Hall before the evening program moves into the Main Museum, with presentations in the Theater and Lower Lobby and private access to the Museum's Main Galleries from 6-8 PM.

Teams will build AI-powered products across:

- E-commerce & storefront experiences
- Merchant operations, inventory, fulfillment & payments
- Restaurants, retail, POS & physical commerce
- AI agents, MCP integrations & workflow automation

But this isn't a traditional hackathon.

Instead of spending the evening watching dozens of back-to-back pitches, every team will turn their project into an exhibit for the AI Commerce Gallery Walk.

After the Gallery Walk, the evening moves into the Main Museum for featured demos, awards, networking, and two hours to explore The Walt Disney Family Museum's Main Galleries.

Attendees, judges, partners, and investors will move through the gallery, interact with live demos, meet the builders, and experience what the future of commerce could actually feel like.

Throughout the day, builders will have access to AI tools, APIs, integrations, technical workshops, mentors, and partner resources to help turn ideas into working products.

The strongest projects will be selected as Featured Exhibits and invited to demo on the main stage before the Gallery Awards.

 Awards include

Best in Gallery

大学卒業後、2020年に新卒でコインチェック入社。マーケティング部においてデータ分析業務、自社ポジション管理およびWeb広告運用をはじめとする新規ユーザー獲得業務、新規通貨取扱い業務、取引所のサービス改善など幅広い業務に従事。2023年9月執行役員、2024年9月執行役員CPO（最高プロダクト責任者）を経て、2026年6月より専門役員 / Head of Product。

磯野 太佑 / ＳＭＢＣ日興証券株式会社 Nikko Open Innovation Lab長 兼 DeFiテクノロジー部長（スペシャルゲスト）

2012年にＳＭＢＣ日興証券に入社し、投資銀行部門に配属。2014年からは同部門にて、主にコンシューマー・リテール（消費財・小売）業界におけるM&Aや資金調達（ファイナンス）業務に従事。2020年、社内ベンチャープログラムへの参加を経て、Nikko Open Innovation Lab（NOIL）に立ち上げと同時に参画。同部では「次世代技術 × 地方創生」プロジェクトをリードし、2021年には「高専インカレチャレンジ」を、2022年には「ふるさと納税」と連動した金融スキームなどのプロジェクトを立ち上げる。2023年には、合弁会社「Proof of Japan」を設立。AIとWeb3技術を活用した日本文化の支援・発信事業を展開する。さらに2025年には、Web3VC大手のHashedが組成した第3号ファンドへの出資を主導し、同社のインキュベーションプログラム「Protocol Camp」を通じた協業を推進。現在は、ＳＭＢＣ日興証券におけるオープンイノベーションの取り組みを牽引しながら、オンチェーン金融の推進に注力している。

小原 冬威 / Komlock lab株式会社

2020年よりソフトウェアエンジニアとしてキャリアをスタート。複数のプロジェクトでフルスタック開発を経験し、フロントエンドからバックエンドまで幅広く携わる。2025年よりブロックチェーン領域に挑戦し、現在はブロックチェーンエンジニアとして活動中。x402プロトコル、Payments MCP、JPYC統合など、AI Agentの自律的な支払い・経済活動を実現する技術に注力している。Zennにて技術記事を積極的に発信している。

坂口 万斎 / コインチェック株式会社 プロダクトエンジニアリング部 リスティング＆プロトコルG｜クリプト基盤Gバックエンドエンジニア。2025年3月にコインチェックに新卒入社し、暗号資産の入出金システムの開発・運用を担当。x402とAIエージェントで遊ぶのが最近の趣味。

Cardene（かるでね）/ JFET株式会社 スマートコントラクトエンジニア

CryptoGames株式会社、Ava Labsにて様々なDappsやスマートコントラクトの開発を担当。ブロックチェーン関連の技術記事をこれまで700記事以上執筆。その経験をもとに『DApps開発入門』という書籍を執筆。AI x ブロックチェーンの領域を主軸に開発・リサーチを行っている。

サラ・ホー / ＳＭＢＣ日興証券株式会社 Nikko Open Innovation Lab

Nikko Open Innovation Labにおいて、ブロックチェーンやAIをはじめとする最先端技術と既存産業との橋渡しに取り組んでいる。新規事業開発やアクセラレーションプログラムの企画・運営、教育・啓発活動に加え、規制に準拠したDeFiプラットフォームの構築にも携わる。また、ブロックチェーンを活用した知的財産の創出・管理に取り組んできた経験を生かし、新興技術による持続的な事業価値および社会的価値の創出について、独自の知見を培ってきた。

 MC・ファシリテーター

山口 夏生 / Komlock lab株式会社 CTO

当日の進行とQ&Aのファシリテーションを担当します。2018年よりCryptoGames株式会社にてテックリードとして7年間ブロックチェーン開発に従事し、CryptoSpells、AstarFarmなど8つ以上のプロジェクトの立ち上げを主導。Komlock lab設立に伴いCTOに就任し、オンチェーン金融やAIエージェント決済など最先端領域の設計&開発を手掛ける。エージェント経済圏共同研究会ではKomlock lab側の技術面を担当。

主催

コインチェック株式会社

「新しい価値交換を、もっと身近に」コインチェックは、2014年8月に暗号資産取引サービス「Coincheck」を開始して以来、金融リテラシーにかかわらず、誰でも使いやすいサービスを提供することにより、「新しい価値交換」を身近に感じられる機会をお客さまに届けてきました。暗号資産やブロックチェーンは日々進化を重ね、より個々人を主体とした「新たな価値交換」を実現しつつありますが、あたらしい技術がもたらす恩恵はまだほんの一部の人にしか行き届いておらず、情報リテラシーによる格差が生じています。コインチェックは、暗号資産やブロックチェーンにより生まれる「新しい価値交換」、またその次に現れる新しいテクノロジーにより実現される変革を誰もが身近に感じられるように、より良いサービスを創出し続けます。

会社紹介資料: https://speakerdeck.com/coincheck_recruit/coincheck-company-description

エンジニア採用サイト: https://engineer-recruit.coincheck.com/

note: https://note.coincheck.com/m/m245fff7b3f4c

Komlock lab株式会社

Komlock labは、「ブロックチェーン×AI Agent」が実現する、自律的な経済圏の創出を目指す集団です。2018年からブロックチェーンサービスの開発・運営を手掛けてきたCryptoGames社のエンタープライズ部門を分社化し2024年に設立。25以上の多様なプロジェクトで培われた豊富な技術と知見を基に、未来の基盤となるテクノロジーを社会に実装します。

エンジニア大募集です！ブロックチェーンにご興味を持った方、当日ぜひKomlockメンバーにお声がけください。

会社紹介: https://komlock-lab.com/

エンジニア募集: https://youtrust.jp/recruitment_posts/a9a1ec572d3c2c27f6131910f6264713

スペシャルゲスト

ＳＭＢＣ日興証券株式会社

ＳＭＢＣ日興証券は、1918年創業の歴史を持つ、日本を代表する総合証券会社のひとつです。ＳＭＢＣグループの中核証券会社として、個人・法人のお客さまに資産運用・投資銀行業務など幅広い金融サービスを提供しています。近年は「Nikko Open Innovation Lab」を中心にブロックチェーン領域への取り組みを加速しており、DeFiテクノロジー部を新設するなど、証券ビジネスとブロックチェーン技術の融合による次世代金融サービスの創出に挑戦しています。

会場協力

株式会社Pacific Meta

Pacific Metaは、「To Create the Standard for Blockchain from Japan」をミッションに、事業戦略の立案からトークン設計、資金調達、マーケティングまで、ブロックチェーン事業の立ち上げと運営を包括的に支援するコンサルティングファームです。創業から3年でグループ累計260件以上・41カ国以上のプロジェクトを支援するグローバルチームです。浜松町の自社オフィス内に構えるイベントスペース「Pacific Hub」を、国内外のブロックチェーンコミュニティをつなぐ場として提供しており、本イベントもPacific Hubにて開催します。

 エージェント経済圏共同研究会について

コインチェックとKomlock labは、2026年5月より「エージェント経済圏共同研究会」を通じて、AIが人間や企業の代理として経済活動に参加する世界で、企業・金融・決済がどう変わるのかを共同で検証しています。AIエージェントを用いた取引モデルの整理、既存規制との整合性、リスク管理・内部管理体制のあり方、x402をはじめとするエージェント間決済プロトコルの研究とユースケース創出に取り組んでいます。
研究会の議論はNADA NEWSで連載として公開中です。第1回はコインチェック 澤村周平とKomlock lab CEO 布目雅登の対話「なぜ今、AIエージェント経済なのか」。本イベントのLTや懇親会では、この研究会の現在地もお話しします。研究会への参加や連携にご関心のある企業・団体の方は、当日Komlock labまたはコインチェックのメンバーにお声がけください。

連載第1回: https://www.nadanews.com/366689/

共同研究のプレスリリース: https://corporate.coincheck.com/press/j5yXEpHV

 翌日開催：Blockchain Summit 2026 Autumn

本イベントの翌日、10月5日(月)には、会場協力のPacific Metaが主催するオンチェーン金融のカンファレンス「Blockchain Summit 2026 Autumn」が大手町サンケイプラザで開催されます（10:00-18:00、参加無料・事前登録制）。テーマは「オンチェーン金融の最前線　進む実装とAI経済圏」。三井住友FG、みずほ銀行、三井物産、野村ホールディングス、a16z cryptoなど、メガバンク・証券・決済事業者・グローバル投資家が登壇します。
日曜日のCrypto Loungeでエンジニアと事業担当の目線から議論し、月曜日のSummitで金融機関の実装の現在地を確かめる。2日続けての参加をおすすめします。

詳細・参加登録: https://luma.com/bcs2026autumn

 注意事項

お申込みは承認制となります。あらかじめご了承ください。

主催者の判断において申込をキャンセルさせて頂く場合がございます。ご了承ください。

当日予告なく時間配分・内容が変更になる可能性がございます。あらかじめご了承ください。

 個人情報の取り扱いについて

イベント参加時にご入力いただいた情報や参加後のアンケート等の個人情報は、コインチェック株式会社の個人情報保護ポリシーに基づき適切に取り扱います。コインチェック株式会社 プライバシーポリシー: https://campaign.coincheck.com/ja/privacy_policy

name: Blockchain Summit 2026 Autumn
description:
English information is available below.

Blockchain Summit 2026 Autumn は、国内外の金融機関・大手事業会社が一堂に会し、金融領域を中心とするブロックチェーンの最新動向とビジネス機会を議論する国際サミットです。

10月5日（月）｜大手町サンケイプラザ｜参加無料・承認制

■ 三井住友FG・みずほ銀行・三井物産・野村HD・a16z crypto など、オンチェーン金融の最前線を担う12名が登壇が決定。

■ 6セッション・タイムテーブルを公開

ステーブルコイン決済・運用、AI経済圏、実業資産・国債のトークン化、暗号資産ETFまで。オンチェーン金融における重要トピックを議論します。

※追加の登壇者・基調講演は順次発表します。※プログラム・登壇者は変更となる場合があります。

■ 各セッションのテーマ

01｜人とAIにとって"当たり前"のインフラへ｜オンチェーン決済の本格導入とその先

既存決済との共存や本格導入に向けた課題に加え、AIエージェントが人に代わって決済を担う未来の可能性について論じます。

02｜決済から運用へ、広がるステーブルコインの活用

ひとつのウォレットで「支払い」と「運用」を完結させるユーザー体験や、その背景にある仕組み・資金流動に着目し、日本における新たな金融サービスの可能性を探ります。

03｜The Global AI Economy｜Where Japan Fits In （※英語セッション / 機械翻訳あり）

AIエージェントによる支払い・取引を支える基盤としてのブロックチェーンの役割と、日本企業がこのグローバルな潮流に参画するための機会について議論します。

04｜「日本の実業資産」オンチェーン化の最先端｜大手事業会社と金融の波

ブランド、コンテンツ、実物資産など、日本企業がこれまで培ってきた本業の価値を、オンチェーンでどのような事業につなげられるのかを掘り下げます。

05｜金融の中核・国債のオンチェーン化｜大手金融機関が語る商用化への道筋

伝統的金融の中核である国債取引へのブロックチェーン活用について、決済や担保管理の視点から商用化に向けた論点を整理します。

06｜暗号資産ETF、実装の現場｜解禁までの課題と論点

日本における暗号資産ETFの実現に向け、必要な制度設計や市場基盤について、指数、カストディ、商品設計それぞれの立場から論じます。

※プログラムおよび登壇者は、予告なく変更・追加となる場合がございます。あらかじめご了承ください。

■ 同会場にて公式ネットワーキングパーティーを開催

※写真は前回（2026年2月）開催時の様子です。

お飲み物とお食事を囲みながら、参加者の皆さまと直接お話しいただける場です。

詳細は下記をご確認ください。

■ 特別協力企業

■ スポンサー

〈Gold Sponsor〉

〈Silver Sponsor〉

■ メディアパートナー

■ 後援

本サミットは、日本経済新聞社が主催するAIカンファレンス「GenAI/SUM」の後援を受けて開催します。AIとブロックチェーンが交差する領域の議論を、両イベントの連携でさらに深めていきます。

開催概要

日程：2026年10月5日（月）

会場：大手町サンケイプラザ 4階ホール（大手町駅A4・E1出口直結）時間：10:00〜18:00

主催：Pacific Meta Group

※ご登録後、事務局にて確認のうえ参加承認をご案内いたします※プログラム・登壇者は後日順次公開いたします。

■ 第1回は登壇者50名超・事前登録1,200名超

2026年2月開催の第1回は、「Japan Fintech Week 2026」の公式関連イベントとして開催。50名超が登壇し、事前登録1,200名超、当日は約550名が来場しました。メガバンク・証券・決済・事業会社・VCなどの意思決定層・実務責任者が参加しました。

みなさまのご来場をお待ちしております。

Blockchain Summit 2026 Autumn is an international summit where financial institutions and major corporations from Japan and abroad come together to discuss the latest developments in blockchain - with a focus on finance - and the business opportunities they create.

Monday, October 5｜Otemachi Sankei Plaza｜Free to attend, registration subject to approval

■ 12 speakers from the front lines of onchain finance confirmed, including Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group, Mizuho Bank, Mitsui & Co., Nomura Holdings, and a16z crypto.

■ Six sessions and the timetable are now available

From stablecoin payments and asset management to the AI economy, the tokenization of real-world business assets and government bonds, and crypto asset ETFs - we will discuss the key topics shaping onchain finance.

*Additional speakers and keynote sessions will be announced on a rolling basis.*The program and speakers are subject to change.

■ Session themes

01｜Infrastructure That People and AI Take for Granted: The Full-Scale Adoption of Onchain Payments and Beyond

Alongside coexistence with existing payment rails and the challenges of full-scale adoption, this session explores a future in which AI agents handle payments on people's behalf.

02｜From Payments to Asset Management: The Expanding Use of Stablecoins

Focusing on the user experience of completing both "paying" and "investing" in a single wallet - and the underlying mechanisms and flows of funds - this session explores the potential for new financial services in Japan.

03｜The Global AI Economy: Where Japan Fits In (*Session in English / machine translation available)

This session discusses blockchain's role as the infrastructure supporting payments and transactions by AI agents, and the opportunities for Japanese companies to take part in this global shift.

04｜The Cutting Edge of Bringing Japan's Real Business Assets Onchain: Major Corporations and the Financial Wave

This session digs into how the value Japanese companies have built in their core businesses - brands, content, physical assets - can be turned into onchain businesses.

05｜Bringing Government Bonds, the Core of Finance, Onchain: Major Financial Institutions on the Path to Commercialization

This session maps out the issues on the path to commercializing blockchain in government bond transactions - the core of traditional finance - from the perspectives of settlement and collateral management.

06｜Crypto Asset ETFs in Practice: Challenges and Issues on the Road to Approval

Looking ahead to crypto asset ETFs in Japan, speakers discuss the regulatory frameworks and market infrastructure required, from the standpoints of indices, custody, and product design.

name: Grayscale x Global Fintech Institute: Privacy, Proof and the Regulatory Perimeter
description:
An official side event of TOKEN2049 Singapore, co-hosted by Global Fintech Institute and Grayscale.

Financial privacy and regulatory accountability are often treated as competing demands. Zooko Wilcox-O'Hearn built Zcash on a premise worth testing in public: both can hold together in the same system. Supervisors across Asia want traceability. Institutions owe their clients confidentiality. The cryptography that serves both is now audited and deployed, moving the discussion from whether privacy can coexist with supervision to how the two are engineered together.

This in-person session brings leadership from the Zcash ecosystem together with institutional investors, regulators, academics and digital asset operators to examine where the regulatory perimeter sits and what it means for allocation, custody and compliance practice.

Explore how financial privacy and regulatory accountability can be designed into the same system.

Understand the tension between supervisory traceability and client confidentiality.

Examine what privacy-preserving infrastructure means for institutional allocation, custody and compliance.

Hear perspectives from the Zcash ecosystem on the practical deployment of privacy technology.

Consider how regulators and institutions across Asia can approach oversight of privacy-preserving digital assets.

Whether you are a regulator, institutional investor, academic or digital asset professional, join the discussion on how financial privacy can work in institutional practice.

Programme

All times are in Singapore time (SGT).

2:30 PM - Registration and welcome
3:00 PM - Opening remarks from Grayscale and Global Fintech Institute
3:10 PM - Panel discussion
4:30 PM - Refreshments and networking
6:00 PM - Close

Discussion Topics

Financial privacy and accountability within the same system

The regulatory perimeter for privacy-preserving digital assets

Client confidentiality and supervisory traceability

Implications for institutional allocation and custody

Compliance practice and the deployment of privacy-preserving cryptography

Speakers

Zooko Wilcox-O'Hearn
Founder, Zcash

Michelle Lai
Executive Chair, Sovright

Liz Steininger
CEO, Least Authority and Industry Fellow, Global Fintech Institute

Moderator: Prof David Lee Kuo Chuen
Chairman, Global Fintech Institute

Further speakers nominated by Grayscale, ZODL and the Zcash Foundation will be announced.

Registration

Event is in person and registration is subject to approval. The venue will be shared with confirmed guests. Places are limited during TOKEN2049 week.

About Global Fintech Institute (GFI)

The Global Fintech Institute (GFI) is a non-profit think tank that fosters collaboration among regulatory bodies, corporations, and academic institutions. Headquartered in Singapore, GFI addresses challenges in the fintech landscape through research, whitepapers, and thought leadership discussions that shape policy and industry standards.

Our flagship initiatives include the Chartered Fintech Professional (CFtP) and Chartered Fintech Associate (CFtA) certifications, which equip professionals with essential skills for the evolving fintech environment.

## Digital Assets Summit 2026

## Programmable Finance: The Next Layer of Global Markets and Systems

The Digital Assets Summit 2026 (DAS2026) returns on 6 October 2026, bringing together senior leaders from financial institutions, regulatory authorities, government agencies, law-enforcement organisations, technology companies and the wider digital-assets ecosystem.

Following the strong success of DAS2025, this year's summit will feature an expanded programme of keynote addresses, expert panels and substantive industry discussions focused on the next phase of institutional digital-asset adoption.

As digital assets move beyond experimentation, the conversation is increasingly shifting towards how blockchain-based infrastructure, tokenised assets and programmable financial systems can operate at scale within global markets.

DAS2026 will examine the opportunities, infrastructure, governance and regulatory considerations shaping this transition.

## What to Expect

The programme will explore key areas including:

- Tokenisation of financial and real-world assets
- Programmable finance and blockchain-based market infrastructure
- Stablecoins, deposit tokens and new settlement rails
- Institutional adoption, custody and wealth management
- The convergence of digital assets and traditional financial markets
- Artificial intelligence and its role in the digital-assets ecosystem
- Regulation, compliance, enforcement and financial-crime prevention
- The evolving roles of banks, intermediaries and market-infrastructure providers

Attendees can expect practical perspectives, candid discussions and deep insights from leaders directly involved in developing, regulating and implementing digital-asset solutions.

## Who Should Attend

DAS2026 is designed for industry professionals, including:

- Financial institutions and banks
- Regulators and government agencies
- Digital-asset and blockchain companies
- Asset managers, investors and family offices
- Custodians, exchanges and infrastructure providers
- Legal, compliance and risk professionals

name: Financial Crime Risks in Digital Assets: A Breakfast Panel
description:

Join our panel during TOKEN2049 Week in Singapore as senior voices from legal, compliance, and industry unpack how financial institutions and digital asset firms are adapting their financial crime programs for this evolving landscape.

The conversation will cover:

- How financial crime operations differ between digital assets and traditional finance, and where those lines are blurring
- The evolving path to securing and managing US licensing applications
- Structuring reliance arrangements with parent companies or broker-dealer partners
- Operating crypto within a multi-product financial institution
- FCR's expanding remit as products diversify - from prediction markets and perpetuals to retail and stablecoin offerings
- Striking the right balance between rigorous onboarding controls and a seamless client experience

name: AI & Formal Verification for Onchain Finance | Token2049 Singapore
description:
AI & Formal Verification for Onchain Finance

Defending DeFi, stablecoins and RWAs in the age of AI-powered attacks.

A focused, invite-only gathering for the researchers, founders, and protocol teams shaping the next era of onchain finance, at a moment when attackers have started turning to AI and defense must move from "tested" to "proven."

This session examines a shift already underway. As stablecoins mature into payment rails and RWAs bring real-world value onchain, the value at stake has surged, while AI is making attacks faster, cheaper, and harder to anticipate. Drawing on real exploit investigations and deep security experience across DeFi, stablecoin, and RWA protocols, the conversation centers on what provable security actually looks like when the threat itself becomes intelligent.

Rather than a one-way panel, this is built for genuine exchange among people solving the same problems. Discussions are structured, candid, and grounded in real systems, giving technical and business leaders room to challenge assumptions, compare defensive approaches, and engage directly with leading researchers and peers navigating the same frontier.

What to Expect

Honest discussion on how AI is reshaping both attack and defence across onchain finance.

Deep dives into recent exploits, failure modes, and the patterns behind them.

A practical look at formal verification, and why provable security is becoming the standard for stablecoins, RWAs, and institutional-grade protocols.

Who Should Attend

Founders - CTOs - Stablecoin & RWA Teams - Protocol Architects - Security Researchers - Auditors - Institutional & DeFi Builders

 Location: Singapore (private venue shared with approved attendees)

Each invitation is personally confirmed.

Seats are extremely limited, and you must confirm.

name: Cardano node diversity celebration day
description:
One network. Many builders. A stronger future.

Cardano node diversity is no longer just an ambition. It is becoming real.

On the 6th October in Singapore, Cardano Diversity Celebration Day will bring together representatives from Cardano's different node implementations to share their progress, compare timelines and discuss how independent implementations can strengthen the network. The event will also introduce the Diversity Ambassador Program and invite feedback on the next phase of this collective effort.

Why does this matter? Because a truly resilient blockchain should never depend on one team, one codebase or one way of solving a problem. Independent node implementations give Cardano more protection, more opportunities for innovation and more freedom to evolve.

Node diversity reduces common-mode risk: when implementations are developed independently, they can reveal different edge cases, validate protocol behaviour from different perspectives. It also creates room for improvements in resource efficiency, observability, tooling and operator experience.

This is not about replacing one implementation with another. It is about building complementary infrastructure - giving Cardano more resilience, more engineering options and greater confidence as the protocol evolves.

Cardano Diversity Celebration Day is where the people building that future come together and where the wider community gets to see what comes next

name: The Capital Summit x Asia Stablecoin Conference
description:
## What Is Shaping Asia's Digital Asset Market Structure?

Stablecoins and tokenized assets are developing differently across Korea, Japan, Hong Kong, Singapore, Southeast Asia, and the UAE - reflecting each market's regulatory, monetary, and capital-market structure.

The next phase will require more than issuance. It will require a complete institutional market structure supporting the full asset lifecycle:

Issuance → Investment → Distribution → Secondary-Market Liquidity → Independent Assessment

The Singapore edition of The Capital Summit x Asia Stablecoin Conference will focus on five areas:

1. Stablecoin Issuance - Which models can scale across Asia?
2. Tokenization - Which Asian assets will attract global investors?
3. Secondary Markets - Where will tokenized assets trade?
4. Distribution - How will institutions bring these assets to market?
5. Ratings - What frameworks will investors require?

## Programme at a Glance

9:00-11:00 a.m.Executive BreakfastCurated seating, introductions, and senior-level networking
12:00-5:00 p.m.Main ConferenceInstitutional keynotes and focused panel discussions
6:00-9:00 p.m.Institutional DinnerRelationship-building and substantive discussions

## Key Topics and Panels

1. Stablecoin Issuance

How are stablecoins growing in Asia - and which models can achieve institutional adoption?

- Regulated and private-sector issuance
- Local-currency stablecoins and USD rails
- Reserves, redemption, custody, and distribution

2. Tokenization

Which Asian assets will attract global institutional investors?

- Funds, treasuries, credit, real estate, and commodities
- Product structures for international distribution
- Ownership, custody, liquidity, and investor protection

3. Secondary Markets

Where will tokenized assets trade and institutional liquidity develop?

- Regulated exchanges and alternative trading venues
- Onchain and hybrid market models
- Market makers, custody, and cross-border settlement

4. Distribution

How will issuers, exchanges, banks, and asset managers reach investors?

- Exchange and institutional partnerships
- Bank, broker, and digital-platform distribution
- Cross-border access to Asian markets

5. Ratings

What information will institutions require before allocating capital?

- Reserve, liquidity, and credit risk
- Legal, counterparty, and technology risk
- Ratings, disclosures, and reporting standards

## Who Will Attend

Senior decision-makers involved across the digital-asset lifecycle:

- Issuers: Stablecoin and tokenized-asset issuers
- Capital: Asset managers, institutional investors, family offices, and venture investors
- Financial Institutions: Banks, securities firms, and payment companies
- Markets: Exchanges, brokers, and secondary-market operators
- Infrastructure: Custodians, settlement providers, and technology companies
- Risk and Policy: Rating agencies, auditors, data providers, regulators, legal professionals, and researchers

## Institutional Objectives

The programme is designed to:

- Connect Asian issuers with global institutional investors
- Introduce asset managers to distribution and infrastructure partners
- Support partnerships among exchanges, banks, and digital platforms
- Identify credible sources of secondary-market liquidity
- Advance institutional ratings and risk-assessment frameworks
- Connect global companies entering Asia with Asian companies seeking international capital

description:
Connecting Financial Institutions, Stablecoins & Digital Asset Infrastructure

Hosted by Cregis - FOMO Pay - Stable - Width
Partner: Tether- MetaComp - 1exchange - CapBridge - CertiK - ZAN -HackenProof - Stablecoin Insider - Activ8

## About the Summit

Onchain finance is becoming increasingly connected with the global financial system.

Stablecoins are moving into payments and settlement, financial institutions are exploring new forms of digital money and tokenized assets, and digital asset security is evolving beyond technology alone to encompass infrastructure, governance and day-to-day operations.

Taking place in Singapore during TOKEN2049 Week, the Institutional Onchain Finance Summit 2026 brings together senior leaders and decision-makers from financial institutions, payments, fintech, stablecoins, digital assets, compliance, security and investment.

Through keynotes, panel discussions and curated networking, the summit provides a focused setting for industry leaders to exchange perspectives on how institutional onchain finance is taking shape today - and what comes next.

## What We'll Discuss

Panel I

What Stablecoins Mean for Banks, Businesses & the Wider Economy

Stablecoins are beginning to reshape how money is held, moved and settled across the global economy. As adoption expands, their impact is extending beyond digital assets into banking, corporate finance, cross-border commerce and access to major currencies.

This panel will explore where stablecoins can improve existing financial services, how banks, payment companies and businesses may participate in the emerging ecosystem, and what wider adoption could mean for liquidity, competition and the movement of money across markets.

Panel II

The New Security Playbook: How Attacks & Defenses Are Evolving Across Digital Assets

Digital asset attacks are increasingly moving beyond code vulnerabilities into infrastructure, identities and operational processes. At the same time, automation, interconnected systems and AI are changing both how attacks are scaled and how threats are detected.

This panel will explore how the security playbook is evolving across smart contracts, signing systems, third-party infrastructure and human workflows - and what organizations need to rethink across prevention, monitoring and incident response.

name: Agentic Money 2026
description:
## AGENTIC MONEY 2026

## When Intelligence Moves Value - Global Payments & Onchain Finance

A new financial landscape is taking shape in 2026 - one in which agents are becoming economic actors, capable of participating in payments, trading, and treasury operations.

Four layers are beginning to converge:

Agents decide. Payment networks move value. Onchain finance provides assets and liquidity. LLM tokens measure and price model usage.

[That is why Money in Motion](https://x.com/moneyinmotion26) [and LongTree Labs](https://x.com/LongTreeLabs) are co-hosting the inaugural Agentic [Money Summit during TOKEN2049 Singapore Week, with PhotonPay](https://x.com/PhotonPay), [DogPay](https://x.com/DogPay_), [United Stables](https://x.com/UTechStables), [AWS, Eddid](https://www.eddid.com.hk/en), [Interlace](https://x.com/InterlaceMoney), [FluxA](https://x.com/FluxA_Official) [and StableTree](https://x.com/stabletree_ai)as our first announced partners.

> Official Website：https://moneyinmotion.xyz/token2049/agenticmoney2026/
> Partnership and sponsorship inquiries: https://t.me/Mix_Web3

Together, we will explore the question at the center of this emerging system:

When agents can move money, access liquidity, and transact across global markets, how must the financial system evolve?

## What We Will Explore

## Panel 1｜Agentic Payments

How can agents gain verifiable, controllable capabilities for payments and treasury operations?

## Panel 2｜Global Trade Corridors

How can stablecoins and local payment networks reshape collections, acquiring, settlement, and clearing in emerging markets?

## Panel 3｜RWA at Scale

From Asset Issuance to Distribution & Liquidity

## Panel 4｜IWhen Wall Street Goes Onchain

Tokenized Equities, Clearing & AI Composability

## The Questions That Connect the Panels

The most important opportunities - and the hardest design choices - appear where these four conversations intersect:

- When an agent manages assets, initiates payments, and executes transactions on behalf of an individual or a business, how should the financial system identify it, and where should the boundaries of permission and responsibility be drawn?
- When card networks, account-to-account payments, and stablecoin networks are all available, how will an agent choose its payment and settlement route?
- Can stablecoin liquidity accumulated through cross-border payments become a source of capital for trading, financing, and collateralization across U.S. equities and RWAs?
- As U.S. equities and other RWAs move onchain, which trading, financing, and collateral operations can agents automate, and where should their permission boundaries be drawn?
- When agents purchase models, data, and compute, LLM tokens measure usage while stablecoins settle payments. Will these two layers remain separate, or will model usage credits emerge that can be traded and settled directly?

## Build the Next Financial System

No single industry can answer these questions alone. Agentic Money 2026 will bring agent and AI product teams, payment institutions, stablecoin infrastructure providers, onchain asset platforms, liquidity providers, model services, banks, compliance organizations, investors, and researchers into the same room.

We want these conversations to lead to concrete outcomes: a new payment rail, an asset that agents can access programmatically, a partner for entering a new market, a clearer rule for managing risk, or a problem worth years of work.

We hope the most important questions, the most experienced practitioners, and the most promising directions can meet here first - and grow into real products, market connections, and long-term partnerships.

AGENTIC MONEY 2026 is an invitation to explore how the next financial system will work - and to help build it together.

We look forward to welcoming you to AGENTIC MONEY 2026 in Singapore.

Benjamin Bathgate | bbathgate@weirfoulds.com

Javier Alvarez, CPA, CFE, CKC | jaalvarez@bdo.com

BDO International Limited

name: DeTaP - Workshop on Decentralisation: Theory and Practice
description:
Decentralisation is a foundational goal of blockchain systems, yet it remains contested, hard to define, and even harder to measure. The 1st Workshop on Decentralisation: Theory and Practice (DeTaP) brings together researchers from cryptography, distributed systems, economics, law, and beyond to examine decentralisation as a concept and a design goal - how to define it, how to measure it, how it interacts with law and policy, and how it compares to decentralisation in other fields.

DeTaP is a single-day workshop co-located with Advances for Financial Technologies (AFT) 2026. The programme will feature a mix of invited and contributed talks, together with dedicated time for open discussion among participants. Our aim is to bring together a cross-disciplinary group and to make space for the kind of open, foundational discussion that decentralisation as a topic invites.

For more information see https://blockchain-technology-lab.github.io/DeTaP/

name: TOKEN2049 Singapore 2026
description:
TOKEN2049 Singapore 2026 runs 7-8 October 2026 at Marina Bay Sands, taking over all five floors of the venue for its biggest edition yet.

## Scale

The organizer expects 25,000+ attendees from 160+ countries, 7,000+ companies, 300+ speakers and 500+ exhibitors, with over 60% of attendees at C-level and more than 1,000 side events across the week.

## Program

Alongside the main stages, the week includes the NEXUS startup competition (500 applicants, 10 finalists pitching on the global stage for equity-free prizes), the TOKEN2049 Origins hackathon (36 hours from concept to working product, with mentorship and a shot at prizes, funding and global recognition), and the Startup Village exhibition area where startups showcase to founders, investors, builders and decision-makers from across the industry.

## Festival and side events

The organizer markets the Singapore edition as a festival and, on its site, invites attendees to experience a "pop-up city" of immersive experiences under one roof at Marina Bay Sands - experiential branding, not a literal temporary city. More than 1,000 side events run across the wider conference week. The official closing party, AFTER2049, returns to the MBS SkyPark on 9 October with Claptone headlining 57 floors above ground, joined by Crusy and residents ANONM, Leon, Milam and Mo-Shi, with 360-degree spatial audio by Polygon Live.

## Tickets

Tickets are on sale now, currently listed at US$599 before the 24 September price increase, payable by credit card or crypto. Get 10% off with our code HASHTAGWEB3.

## Who attends

Founders, investors, developers, exchange and protocol teams, institutions, policymakers and media - anyone shaping the global crypto industry. As Binance founder Changpeng Zhao puts it, it is where everybody comes together and the most important conversations happen.

## Speakers

Selected speakers include Shayne Coplan (Polymarket), Balaji Srinivasan (The Network State), Arthur Hayes (Maelstrom), Adena Friedman (Nasdaq), Richard Teng (Binance), Joseph Lubin (Ethereum / MetaMask), Charles Hoskinson (Input Output Group), Justin Sun (TRON) and Max Verstappen (Oracle Red Bull Racing).

See the [official speaker directory](https://www.token2049.com/singapore/speakers) for the full roster.

name: OKX Dev Day 2026
description:
## OKX DEV DAY 2026 | Developer Hackathon

## Build a Market. Build a Company.

Build with X Layer and OKX AI. Create an application for tokenized stocks or real-world assets, an onchain marketplace, an agent service or an AI-native business.

OKX Dev Day is a developer hackathon that starts online and culminates in a live finale in Singapore. Build a working project with your team and connect with OKX leadership, leading RWA, AI and crypto partners, and venture capital firms.

---

Up to US$100K across winning teams

Applications closed. [For selected teams, please refer to the builder kit here](https://www.okx.com/learn/okx-dev-day-builder-kit).

---

Select Register to complete one application per team.

‼ Builder applications only. Requesting to join is not a public event registration or a ticket to the live finale. The finale is limited to selected teams and invited guests. Applying does not guarantee selection.

## What you can build

Choose one primary track when you apply:

---

1. X Layer: Tokenized stocks and RWA

https://web3.okx.com/xlayer

Build applications and infrastructure that use tokenized stocks or real-world assets as onchain building blocks on X Layer. Examples include data and portfolio tools, asset-based payment or commerce experiences, investor or issuer tooling and new ways for users and assets to interact onchain.

2. OKX AI: Agents and AI-native businesses

https://www.okx.ai/

Build agent services and AI-native products for discovery, coordination, collaboration and monetisation. Examples include agent-service marketplaces, data or API services and tools that help agents work or transact with users and other agents.

---

Your project may use both X Layer and OKX AI, but it will be reviewed under one primary track. If both apply, choose the track that best represents the core of your project.

Bring a clear problem and a build your team can deliver. We are looking for working products, not pitch decks.

Final problem statements, technical requirements and judging criteria will be shared with selected teams.

## Key dates

all times are in UTC +00:00 unless stated otherwise

▫Applications close: 15 September 2026 23:59 (extended)

▫Online build period: 17 to 25 September 2026

▫Project submission: 25 September 2026

▫Finalist selection: 28 to 30 September 2026

▫Live finale in Singapore: 7 October 2026

## What selected teams get

- A share of the US$100K prize pool
- Technical resources, onboarding and build support for X Layer and OKX AI
- Opportunities to connect with OKX product leaders, partners and investors
- The chance to become a finalist and demo live in Singapore
- Hackathon prizes and awards, with the prize pool and details to be announced
- OKX Dev Day merchandise, subject to availability

## Prize pool

Up to US$100K is available across winning teams.

Two ways to compete

1. In person, Singapore finale. Teams that demo live on 7 October compete for the headline awards in each track. The largest share of the pool sits here.
2. Remote. Teams that build and submit but cannot travel are still judged and can still win.

Awards are subject to eligibility and the full Terms and Conditions.

## Meet our partners

Joining OKX Dev Day as speakers, judges, mentors and technical experts.

Program partners:

▫[Amazon Web Services](https://x.com/awscloud)

▫[Morningstar](https://x.com/MorningstarInc?lang=en)

▫[Paxos](http://x.com/paxoslabs)

▫[MoonPay](https://x.com/moonpay)

▫[Centrifuge](https://x.com/centrifuge)

▫[xStocks](https://x.com/xStocksFi)

▫[Plug and Play](https://www.plugandplayapac.com/)

▫[Maximum Frequency Ventures](https://www.mf.xyz/)

▫[Liminal](https://liminal.build/)

Community partner:

▫[Claude Code Singapore](https://claudecode.sg/)

▫[Easy](https://x.com/easya_app)[A](https://x.com/MorningstarInc?lang=en)

▫[Surgence Labs](https://x.com/surgence_io)

## What teams need to submit

1. Team members and contact information
2. High-level summary of what the team plans to build

After being selected, teams will be expected to provide the following during the Dev Day event on 7 October:

- Working prototype
- GitHub repository
- Prepare to present in front of a panel of judges for 3-5 minutes.

## How selection works

1. Submit one team application through this page by 15 September 2026 at 23:59 UTC+0 (extended, originally 11 September)
2. OKX reviews the team's idea, technical plan and ability to deliver.
3. Selected teams receive the online hackathon details by email.
4. Teams build online and submit a working project by 25 September.
5. Submitted projects are reviewed before finalists are invited to the Singapore event.

We may not be able to provide individual feedback on every application.

Ready to apply? Select Register and complete the builder application.

Travel

OKX does not pay for travel, accommodation, visas or personal expenses. Finalist teams are responsible for getting to Singapore and covering those costs.

Do not book non-refundable travel until OKX confirms your finalist place and attendance details in writing.

## FAQs

Does Request to Join give me a ticket to the finale?

No. Request to Join opens the builder application. Your request will remain pending while applications and projects are reviewed. Only confirmed finalists will be approved in Luma for the Singapore finale.

Is the full hackathon in Singapore?

No. Teams build online from 17 to 25 September. Only the live finale takes place in Singapore.

Does OKX cover travel?

No. Teams cover their own travel, accommodation, visas and personal expenses.

What do I submit?

Selected teams will receive the final checklist before the online build period. It will cover the project description, working demo, OKX integration and technical links.

Are there prizes?

Categories, amounts and terms will be announced soon.

Can I apply on my own?

Yes. You can apply on your own or as part of a team of up to four people. Solo applicants are responsible for delivering the project and attending the Singapore finale if selected.

By participating in this event, you agree to the Event Participation Terms, Conditions and Disclaimers (https://www.okx.com/learn/okx-dev-day-terms ).

name: Privacy Summit
description:
Monday, 7th October 2026.

The Privacy Summit of Token2049 Singapore.

 Venue: Paya Lebar Quarter

Join an event organized by StarkWare for everyone interested in privacy.

We are bringing privacy and compliance into the same room for a practical conversation about where crypto privacy goes next. The event will bring together
privacy protocol teams, cryptographic researchers, application builders, wallet teams, institutions, policy thinkers, and people who care about making
private crypto systems usable.

The program will include discussions on the future of onchain privacy, the relationship between privacy and compliance, and the technical approaches
powering the next generation of private applications. We will also feature live demos from teams building real privacy products today.

Topics include

State of onchain privacy in 2026

Compliance and privacy: can they coexist?

Practical privacy: private payments, private DeFi, shielded assets, and real user applications

ZK, FHE, MPC, and TEEs: which tools fit which privacy use cases?

Privacy protocols in production: what is live, what is hard, and what still needs to be built?

Institutional privacy: what do funds, fintechs, and regulated actors need before using public blockchains?

Wallet privacy: how do we make private crypto usable for normal users?

What should the next generation of privacy builders focus on?

Who this is for

Cypherpunks, privacy protocol teams, cryptographic researchers, privacy engineers, application builders, wallet builders, policy thinkers, and anyone who
cares about the future of crypto privacy.

This event is open to everyone interested in privacy. Register and join. Privacy should not be a niche conversation, we believe it should be for all.

Speakers

Eli Ben-Sasson (Starkware), Harsh Bajpai (Zcash), Carter (Fhenix), to be announced.

Hosted by

StarkWare

StarkWare is the zero-knowledge proving company behind Starknet, StarkEx, and SN Stack, building infrastructure for scalable, secure, and private onchain
applications. StarkWare's proof stack has settled more than $2.8T in cumulative volume across venues including dYdX v3, Extended, edgeX, Paradex, and ApeX
Pro, with over 1B transactions on StarkEx, 310M transactions on Starknet, and zero proof failures since production launch in 2020. Starknet is a Stage 1
rollup on L2BEAT, with average transaction fees under $0.001 through 2025, and the stack has a concrete path toward post-quantum security. StarkWare is
valued at $8B and backed by Paradigm, Sequoia, and Coatue. Learn more at https://www.starkware.co/.

name: The Real Yield Happy Hour by HoneyB
description:
For much of DeFi's history, "yield" was fueled by token incentives, emissions, and liquidity mining. High APYs attracted capital, but too often the yield disappeared when the incentives stopped.

That is changing.

Credit, equities, Treasuries, ETFs, and institutional income strategies are moving onchain, bringing yield generated by real economic activity into DeFi. Interest paid by borrowers. Dividends from companies. Income from public markets. Cash flows that exist beyond token incentives.

As TradFi and DeFi converge, onchain yield is evolving from something created for crypto into a new distribution layer for the world's income-producing assets.

As the saying goes: "If you don't know where the yield is coming from, you are the yield."

Join HoneyB for drinks and a conversation about the next generation of real yield and onchain capital markets.

name: RWA Beyond the Hype: VIP Private Dinner
description:
## 超越热度：RWA 真正落地，还缺什么？

在 TOKEN2049 的第一天夜晚，BiFu 设宴做东，我们邀请 BiFu VIP 及行业嘉宾参与「超越热度：RWA 真正落地，还缺什么？」VIP 私享晚宴。

放下白天的展会的匆忙和喧嚣，我们希望用一顿丰盛的高级自助晚餐与美酒款待。作为新一代全域资产交易网络，BiFu 期待在这场定向邀请的闭门晚宴中，与 RWA 核心建设者、资本及基础设施代表相聚，共同探讨资产产品化与真实流动的实现路径。

本次活动采用邀请制入场，为嘉宾提供高密度、私密的行业连接，您若认为自己属于被邀请的，请填写报名信息，我们审核后会联系您。

> 如有商务或合作需求，请联系 [connect@bifu.co](https://mailto:connect@bifu.co)，或telegram @takshire

## 时间流程｜Agenda

- 17:00-17:30　嘉宾签到、欢迎酒与自由交流
- 17:30-18:10　主持开场、自助晚餐与相互认识
- 18:15-18:45　BiFu CEO、产品负责人及特邀嘉宾分享／主题对谈
- 18:45-19:12　继续用餐、自由交流与第一轮抽奖
- 19:12-19:50　现场表演与集体合影
- 19:50-20:00　自由交流与第二场转场

## 现场嘉宾｜Who Is in the Room

RWA 项目与资产方、交易平台与多资产平台、基金／做市商／VC、财富管理机构与家族办公室、稳定币／支付／托管／安全服务商、金融基础设施团队、新加坡 FinTech 与 Web3 生态代表，以及精选媒体、研究者与专业社群。

## 主办方｜Host：BiFu

成立于 2023 年，BiFu 是融通 Web2 与 Web3 全域资产交易的先锋级平台。

BiFu 是连接数字资产与更广泛全球市场的统一资产网络。我们打破传统金融边界，让用户只需一个账户，即可自由交易 Crypto、外汇、大宗商品、美港股及 RWA。凭借统一账户体系、极速稳定性能、完备合规与社区赋能，BiFu 致力于让全球优质财富走向平权，确保无论机会出现在哪个市场，用户都已「在场」。

## 关于 BiNet｜全域资产交易网络

BiNet 是 BiFu 打造的全域资产交易网络，也是「One Account, Trade the World」这句承诺的底层支撑。

它将加密资产、外汇、大宗商品、股票、RWA 与预测市场六大类市场整合进统一账户体系。用户只需完成一次身份认证，即可用同一个账户、同一笔资金进入全部市场。

在这套体系之下，BiNet 以统一身份、统一资金、统一风控、统一合规四项基础能力为骨架，辅以聚合 200 余家全球交易所的流动性网络、亚毫秒级交易引擎与智能路由，让跨市场交易像在单一市场中一样连贯、顺畅。

资产之间的墙正在被拆除，BiNet 要做的，就是把全球市场装进一个账户。

## 关于 BiFu 财富板块｜BiFu Wealth

RWA 的价值不只在于资产上链，更在于让普通投资者真正有机会参与其中。

BiFu 财富板块面向既有稳健收益诉求、又希望保留资金灵活性的用户，提供一站式资产配置入口。依托 BiNet 的统一账户与跨市场基础设施，RWA 将与加密资产、外汇、大宗商品共同构成多元资产配置体系。

通过将真实世界资产引入链上配置框架，财富板块让过去仅向机构开放的收益来源，逐步成为普通投资者可触达、可理解、可配置的选项。

让 RWA 从行业热词变成普通投资者账户里的真实持仓，这是 BiFu 财富板块对「金融平权」的回答，也是我们对「RWA 真正落地」这个命题给出的实践。

## RWA Beyond the Hype: What Will Real Adoption Take?

On the first evening of TOKEN2049, dinner is on BiFu. We cordially invite BiFu VIPs and industry guests to be our guests at the VIP Private Dinner, "RWA Beyond the Hype: What Will Real Adoption Take?"

Step away from the conference buzz and let us treat you to a premium buffet and free-flowing drinks. As a next-generation unified asset trading network, BiFu is bringing together core RWA builders, capital providers, and infrastructure leaders for an intimate, closed-door discussion on the path from asset productization to real market liquidity.

This exclusive gathering is invite-only, offering a private setting for focused, high-value industry connections.

## Agenda

- 17:00-17:30　Guest check-in, welcome drinks, and networking
- 17:30-18:10　Opening remarks, buffet dinner, and introductions
- 18:15-18:45　Insights and featured discussion with the BiFu CEO, product lead, and invited guests
- 18:45-19:12　Dinner, networking, and the first lucky draw
- 19:12-19:50　Live performance and group photo
- 19:50-20:00　Networking and transition to the second session

## Who Is in the Room

RWA projects and asset originators; exchanges and multi-asset platforms; funds, market makers, and VCs; wealth managers and family offices; stablecoin, payment, custody, and security providers; financial infrastructure teams; representatives from Singapore's FinTech and Web3 ecosystems; and selected media, researchers, and professional communities.

## Host: BiFu

Founded in 2023, BiFu is a pioneering platform connecting Web2 and Web3 markets through unified, multi-asset trading.

BiFu is a unified asset network connecting digital assets with the broader global financial markets. By breaking down traditional market boundaries, BiFu enables users to access Crypto, foreign exchange, commodities, US and Hong Kong equities, and RWA through a single account.

Supported by a unified account system, fast and stable performance, a comprehensive compliance framework, and community participation, BiFu is working to make global wealth opportunities more accessible - so that wherever an opportunity appears, users are already there.

## About BiNet｜The Unified Asset Trading Network

BiNet is the unified asset trading network developed by BiFu and the infrastructure behind the promise: "One Account, Trade the World."

It brings six market categories - Crypto, foreign exchange, commodities, equities, RWA, and prediction markets - into one unified account system. With a single identity verification process, users can access these markets through the same account and the same pool of funds.

BiNet is built on four core capabilities: unified identity, unified funds, unified risk management, and unified compliance. Together with a liquidity network aggregating more than 200 global exchanges, a sub-millisecond trading engine, and intelligent routing, this infrastructure is designed to make cross-market trading as continuous and straightforward as trading within a single market.

The walls between asset classes are coming down. BiNet's goal is to bring global markets into one account.

## About BiFu Wealth

The value of RWA lies not only in bringing assets on-chain, but in giving everyday investors a real opportunity to participate.

BiFu Wealth is designed for users seeking steady return opportunities while retaining the flexibility to respond to changing markets. It provides a single entry point for diversified asset allocation. Supported by BiNet's unified account and cross-market infrastructure, RWA sits alongside Crypto, foreign exchange, and commodities within a broader multi-asset portfolio framework.

By bringing real-world assets into an on-chain allocation framework, BiFu Wealth is making sources of return that were once available mainly to institutions increasingly accessible, understandable, and investable for everyday users.

Turning RWA from an industry buzzword into a real holding in an everyday investor's account is BiFu Wealth's answer to financial inclusion - and our practical response to what it means to bring RWA into real-world adoption.

name: TOKEN2049 Singapore. Quantum Security for Digital Assets with Industry Leaders
description:
Quantum Security for Digital Assets

This private technical event brings together industry leaders, protocol engineers, cryptography researchers, digital asset specialists and institutional stakeholders to examine the emerging security requirements of digital assets in a post quantum environment.

The discussion will focus on the cryptographic foundations required to protect digital asset infrastructure as quantum computing develops, including digital signatures, transaction authentication, identity, key management, consensus security and the protection of blockchain execution environments.

Panels with industry leaders will be followed by relaxed networking with senior peers over food and drinks.

Particular attention will be given to the transition from conventional elliptic curve cryptography toward post quantum cryptographic systems and the practical considerations involved in implementing these mechanisms at protocol level.

Topics will include

- Post quantum digital signatures and transaction authentication
- Quantum resistant identity and account structures
- Key generation, address derivation and key lifecycle management
- Post quantum consensus and validator communication
- Cryptographic verification within distributed systems
- Quantum resistant smart contract infrastructure
- Migration considerations for existing digital asset systems
- Security implications for institutional digital asset custody and infrastructure.
- The discussion will also examine how post quantum cryptography can be integrated throughout a blockchain protocol rather than being implemented as an isolated security layer.

Quantova will present its approach to post quantum blockchain architecture, including the Quantova Virtual Machine and its implementation of PQR cryptographic primitives across transaction signing, account creation, consensus and execution.

Attendees will have the opportunity to examine the practical relationship between cryptographic primitives, protocol architecture and application execution, with discussion focused on implementation rather than commercial promotion.

About organizers:

- [Quantova](https://Quantova.org) runs a post-quantum Layer 1 network built from first principles to issue, move, settle and protect digital value: digital identity, stablecoins, tokenised real-world assets, payments and institutional settlement, without inheriting a future migration burden.
- [Quantova launched QDock.io](https://QDock.io), the development environment supporting post quantum application development, together with the underlying cryptographic libraries, compilation tooling and deployment infrastructure used within the Quantova environment.

[Further technical information is available at Quantova.org](https://Quantova.org)

HackenProof is a bug bounty and crowdsourced security platform connecting companies with a global network of white-hat security researchers. The platform supports more than 400 programs, with over $26 million paid in bounties and a community of more than 85,000 ethical hackers.

Anna Tutova has been active in the digital asset industry for many years, working at the intersection of cryptocurrency regulation, institutional finance and quantum security. She has contributed to international regulatory and industry discussions and spoken at events across multiple regions, including on the evolving relationship between digital assets, regulation and post-quantum security.

name: The Corridor ASIA & EUROPE. Two Regimes, One Rail. (Singapore ⇆ Vienna as execution examples).
description:
For the first time both ends of the corridor are writing the same rulebook at the same time.

MiCAR is fully in force in the EU. In Singapore, MAS has its draft stablecoin law out for consultation until 16 October, nine days after this evening. Both ask for full reserves, redemption at par and orderly winddown. Neither answers the practical question for a bank, a payment institution or an exchange: who moves money between the two regimes, at what cost, and what still breaks in the middle.

One keynote, one panel, done by six to eight, because the point of the evening is the two hours of conversation that follow.

Hosted by Advantage Austria, the event will be proudly sponsored by Black Manta Capital, TaxBit, EY Law, Bluecode, Talos and Digital Asset Organisation Austria.

18:30 Welcome by Vera Maier, Commercial Counsellor, ADVANTAGE AUSTRIA, Singapore, and the Austrian Embassy

18:40 The corridor in three numbers. Christian Niedermueller, CEO LDC EU,

18:45 Keynote: Two regimes, one rail. MAS meets MiCAR. Dr. Max Bernt, Managing Director APAC & EMEA and Global Head of Regulatory Affairs, Taxbit

19:00 Panel: "Who is actually moving money? :: C O R R I D O R - C A S E S"

Josiah Senu: Co-founder and CEO, Zuba. Bank-grade stablecoin rails across emerging markets

Christian Lechner: Chief Business Development Officer, Bluecode. Global Payment Roaming network for digital wallets (Discover, Alipay+, UnionPay,...)

Frank van Zegveld: Talos. Institutional-grade technology and data across the full digital asset investment lifecycle: liquidity sourcing, price discovery, trading, settlement and portfolio management

19:50 Closing words and toast, Dr. Martin Hanzl, EY Law: the corridor in practice, companies putting down their tents in Austria and the EU

20:00 Austrian buffet, wine and beer, off-the-record conversation until 22:00

How the evening works. One room, one hour, sixty people who each decide something. Everything said on the floor is under the Chatham House rule: what is said may be used, who said it is not. No recording, no decks, no product pitches. One keynote, one panel, done by ten to eight, because the point of the evening is the two hours of conversation that follow.

description:
The future of payments is being built for the real world.

Join StraitsX, RedotPay, Monad Foundation, and Avenia on the sidelines of TOKEN2049 for an evening bringing together the people building how money moves, settles and gets spent.

Connect with founders, operators and industry leaders across payments, stablecoins, wallets, exchanges, cross-border settlement and crypto infrastructure, and exchange ideas on the opportunities, challenges and infrastructure shaping the next generation of payments.

No panels, no presentations. Just drinks, good conversations, and meaningful connections with the people building real-world payments.

About StraitsX

StraitsX is the stablecoin-native settlement layer powering global finance and a Major Payment Institution licensed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore. As the issuer of XSGD and XUSD, StraitsX leverages blockchain technology to enable seamless payments interoperability and stablecoin-backed card issuance. Its infrastructure offers innovative tools for liquidity management and cross-border transactions, enabling businesses to integrate stablecoins into everyday payment flows. Through partnerships with leading financial institutions and payment technology partners, StraitsX delivers secure, regulated payment solutions that bridge traditional finance and the digital economy.

About RedotPay

RedotPay is a global stablecoin-based payment fintech that integrates blockchain solutions with traditional banking and finance infrastructures. Our intuitive platform empowers millions around the world to spend and send digital assets, ensuring faster, more accessible and inclusive financial services. RedotPay advances financial inclusion for the unbanked and supports crypto enthusiasts, driving global adoption of secure and flexible stablecoin-powered financial solutions to bring crypto to real life.

About Monad Foundation

The Monad Foundation is an independent organization that supports the development, adoption, and growth of the Monad blockchain network, a high-performance, institutional-grade Layer 1 blockchain enabling the future of the EVM. The Monad Foundation supports open-source research, developer grants, and ecosystem initiatives that push the boundaries of decentralized computing.

About Avenia

Avenia is a stablecoin infrastructure company connecting Latam's financial system to the global digital dollar economy. Through a single API, Avenia enables fintechs, wallets, and payment companies to move between Pix, BRL, and stablecoins in real time, powering cross-border payments, FX, and on/off-ramp flows with built-in compliance. Avenia operates institutional-grade rails that make Brazilian reais programmable, interoperable, and instantly available on-chain.

name: The Crossing: Engineering Trust in Institutional Digital Finance
description:
An invitation-only VIP reception on the evening of TOKEN2049 Day 1, co-hosted by Safeheron, The Responsible Fintech Institute, DK Bank, Cloudflare and VerifyVASP.

Traditional finance is crossing to digital assets. Not as an experiment anymore, but as a route that has to work every time - for real money, under real rules.

No one company supplies that crossing. Between them, these five cover it end to end:

- Safeheron - the vessel. Open-source MPC and TEE self-custody, so the keys stay yours the whole way across.
- The Responsible Fintech Institute - the charts. Independent standards and published research that make the route defensible.
- DK Bank - the harbour. The official bank of Bhutan's Gelephu Mindfulness City, built for digital assets from day one.
- Cloudflare - the lanes. The network it all runs over, reaching 95% of the world's internet users in roughly 50 milliseconds.
- VerifyVASP - the manifest. Travel Rule at institutional scale: who is on the other end, verified before the value moves.

Five claims, and every one of them checkable.

Then drinks, canapés, and three hours with everyone else who is somewhere mid-crossing.

Places are limited. Request your invitation early.

## About Hosts

Safeheron

Safeheron is the world's leading digital asset self-custody provider. Built on fully in-house developed, open-source Secure Multi-Party Computation (MPC) and Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) technologies, Safeheron delivers institutional-grade self-custody infrastructure and industry-specific solutions at the highest security standards. Its clients span payment firms, liquidity providers (OTC), digital banks, RWA platforms, trust and asset managers, and commodity trade finance - enabling 100% client control over private keys and assets, and powering full lifecycle digital asset management, operations, and business growth.

The Responsible Fintech Institute

The Responsible Fintech Institute (RFI) is a global nonprofit organisation based in Singapore. Its goal is to create a safe, trustworthy and reliable future for digital finance by building the digital utilities that support responsible innovation. RFI brings together public and private sector stakeholders to help build the rules and technology needed for new digital financial tools, and to make the digital asset sector sustainable and inclusive.

DK Bank

DK Bank is the official bank of Bhutan's Gelephu Mindfulness City. DK Bank provides comprehensive financial services, including handling digital assets, and supports GMC's ambitious development plan.

Cloudflare

Cloudflare's network connects directly with virtually every service provider and cloud provider, reaching 95% of the world's internet users within approximately 50 milliseconds. One of the world's largest networks - powering all services across data centers and delivering unmatched performance, security, and reliability. Every service runs in every data center. Your users get a fast, consistent experience - everywhere.

VerifyVASP

VerifyVASP Pte. Ltd. is a leading Travel Rule solution provider delivering secure, scalable compliance infrastructure for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) worldwide. VerifyVASP offers an end-to-end compliance suite encompassing counterparty due diligence, interoperable messaging protocols, on-chain risk analytics, and advisory on Travel Rule and data protection requirements. Extending beyond compliance, VerifyVASP provides advanced solutions for global law enforcement agencies, enabling the prevention, detection, and investigation of illicit activities involving digital assets.
